title: Doctors Assault Case: Bombay High Court Cancels Shinde Sena Corporator Ramesh Mhatre's Bail; Urges Doctors To Withdraw Strike Call
description: The Bombay High Court in a special sitting on Saturday, cancelled the bail granted to Ramesh Mhatre, the sitting corporator from Shiv Sena (Eknath Shinde), booked for assaulting three doctors of civic-run hospital.
